description: Return one MCP App card of the worst Milwaukee restaurants. Pass limit 500 so the card ranks a wide recent window. One call is enough. Do not page, and do not quote inspector comments.

limit.description: Number of records per request (1-500). Use 500 to get maximum data per call.

offset.description: Number of records to skip, for pagination. Pass the previous response's next_offset to get the next page. Default 0.

name: get_milwaukee_inspections
